name: East Tennessee Patriot Project
researcher_notes: A January 2009 Federal Register notice states the November 2002 FERC order authorized 93.6 miles of new mainline pipeline for the Patriot Project (docket CP01-415). In that notice East Tennessee asked to cancel only a 7.04 mile lateral and several loops and uprates, and said it had completed the facilities needed to serve firm shippers. The new mainline is not on the cancel list, so it appears built, but no source found states the as-built length, so 93.6 miles is the authorized figure. Oil and Gas Journal describes a 94 mile, 24 inch extension from Wythe County, Virginia, to Rockingham County, North Carolina, and Power Engineering reports construction start. Expected in service 2003; no in-service article found, so status operating is inferred from the 2009 notice. Not covered by the existing Main Line row (no endpoints, length 2456 mi system row) or Ridgeline or System Alignment rows. Owner not staged: East Tennessee Natural Gas is owned by Enbridge, same as the Main Line row, but no ref was checked here and the entity lookup found no exact hit; add on the owners tab. Route not researched; FERC alignment sheets would be the first source. Row shape follows the expansion convention.
